documents.title: 樺太全圖 (Karafuto complete map)
documents.institution: National Diet Library, Japan / Karafuto Government
documents.publicationCitation: 樺太庁, 樺太全圖, 1:700,000, June 1923. NDL call no. YG813-293; NDL bibliographic ID 000008247314.
documents.notes: Concrete government-produced full map of Karafuto located in the National Diet Library catalog. Suitable as authoritative pre-1945 cartographic evidence for southern Sakhalin coastline/administrative extent after reproducible raster acquisition, rights review, controlled georeferencing and validation.

documents.title: 千島列島地図集成 — prewar Kuril Islands Land Survey Department map corpus
documents.institution: National Diet Library, Japan / Imperial Japanese Land Survey Department

date.note: The NDL record is for a later compiled edition whose identified map creator is the Imperial Japanese Land Survey Department; original-sheet dates vary.

authority: 大日本帝國陸地測量部 / 陸軍参謀本部陸地測量部 (Imperial Japanese Land Survey Department)
documents.publicationCitation: National Diet Library bibliographic ID 000003564289; map corpus at 1:50,000–1:1,000,000 attributed to the Imperial Japanese Land Survey Department.
documents.notes: Locates the authoritative pre-1945 land-survey map lineage for the Kuril chain. Original constituent sheets, dates and coverage must be enumerated and acquired before production geometry is derived.

documents.title: Prewar Navy Hydrographic Department maps of the Kuril Islands
documents.institution: National Diet Library, Japan / Japanese Navy Hydrographic Department

date.note: Concrete NDL holdings include Matsuwa/Rasshua (1928), Shumshu vicinity (1940), Paramushir (1929), Urup (1918) and other island sheets.

authority: 海軍省水路部 (Navy Ministry Hydrographic Department)
documents.notes: Independent government hydrographic mapping corroborates the existence and shape of named Kuril islands immediately before 1945. It is a cross-check/source lineage, not a substitute for enumerating the complete production sheet set.
